title.narrative: Community Cohesion and Capacity Strengthening for Peacebuilding

description.narrative: The project works with vulnerable rural communities in El Salvador to rebuild social ties and promote a culture of peace facing displacement, violence and human rights abuses. These experiences continue to affect people through trauma, weakened community organisation, and a loss of connection between younger and older generations. A key issue the project addresses is the breakdown of social cohesion and leadership, especially among young people with limited knowledge of their communities’ history, which weakens their sense of identity and their ability to take on leadership roles. At the same time, survivors of past violence still seek recognition, dignity and justice. The project aims to bring about two main changes. First, it will help communities—especially women, young people and local leaders—strengthen their organisation and participation in community life. Second, it will support young people and women to learn about historical memory and contribute to building a culture of peace, ensuring that past injustices are remembered and not repeated. To achieve this, the project will combine several practical approaches. It will provide psychosocial support to individuals and groups affected by trauma, helping them to heal and engage more confidently in community life. It will also run training workshops and leadership programmes, particularly for young people, using participatory and experiential methods that connect personal stories with wider historical processes.
